title: SenseTime’s Galaxy Project targets domestic AI chip scale-up
slides: Can SenseTime crack China's chip bottleneck?
Galaxy Project aims mass domestic AI chips.
But one supplier alone cannot meet demand.
Your AI projects now depend on local supply.
Test Galaxy chips before rivals lock capacity.
thread_text:
1. Can SenseTime break the bottleneck?

A single supplier can’t meet demand — even with Galaxy’s mass domestic chips.

2. Galaxy’s massive plan.

The project aims to produce AI chips locally at scale, but volume alone isn’t the fix.

3. Your projects rely on local supply.

Your AI work now depends on what’s available domestically, not global vendors.

4. The real bottleneck is capacity.

If rivals lock chip supply first, your deployment stalls — Galaxy can’t cover everyone.

5. Test Galaxy chips this week.

Run a small inference workload on a Galaxy test unit before others reserve the next batch.
